_comment: Declarative app settings for the POC instance. This file is the source of
truth: the deploy pipeline applies it on every run, so a portal edit is
Values may reference pipeline variables as ${NAME}. Nothing secret belongs
in this file - put the secret in a pipeline variable group or Key Vault and
reference it, so git only ever holds the shape.
WEBSITE_*, FUNCTIONS_*) are deliberately ABSENT: Azure and Terraform own
those, and listing them here would mean two owners for one value.
